contexts.text: Increments of good and truth in the external man.
The blessing of Jehovah = increments... in good and truth, or in life and doctrine. AC 4981:end.
Increase to what is indefinite. Signified.
Increase of the good of love and truth of faith. Signified.
According to the increase of good. Signified.
Increments of the life (of charity) can be given in proportion as...
According to the increments of wisdom.
According to the increase and decrease of love with them.
The increments and increasings from thinner to grosser, or from rarer to denser.
That this comes forth from the continual increments of hereditary evil.
Man lets himself into more and more Societies of Heaven according to the increments of wisdom; and into more and more interior ones according to the increments of good.
